title: Adherence in Chronic Adrenal Insufficiency
brief_summary: Adherence, concerns and satisfaction with information in German patients with adrenal insufficiency as well as the influence of a standardized education program will be assessed by a compared cross-sectional and longitudinal study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \> 18 years
* Patient's written informed consent
* Ability to comply with the protocol procedures
* Patients with chronic adrenal insufficiency under established stable replacement therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years
